text:
ana: Heads-up — rolling out Private v2.5 starting next week. Key highlights: FedRAMP readiness docs, FIPS 140-2 KMS integration, and a supported air-gapped installer. Will start with a small pilot and ramp to GA by end of quarter. Please read details below and react if your team needs to be on the pilot. :tada:

jia: Timeline + migration notes: pilot signups open Mon 09:00 PT, pilot window 2 weeks, GA targeted for 2026-04-30. Docs: https://confluence.redwood/internal/private/v2.5-release-plan (internal)

sam: Security note — FIPS mode requires customers to supply a FIPS-certified KMS endpoint or use our HSM-backed KMS (partner option). Key wrap changes will be opt-in; see the upgrade checklist. Also: automated key rotation in v2.5 is disabled by default for air-gapped installs.

oliver: SRE/measured rollouts — canary will be 10% of pilot accounts for 48h, then 40% for 72h, then full pilot. Oncall for the pilot: @oliver (primary), @jia (backup). Please pin runbooks: /runbooks/private-v2.5-canary.md

maria: CS — we'll offer 6 free migration hours to pilot customers. Can we get a one-pager for CSMs with checklist + known issues?

ryan: Sales — need an internal playbook + customer FAQ. Any cert language for enterprise contracts (FedRAMP/FIPS) we can share?

laura: Legal — compliance pack (FedRAMP artifacts, audit checklist) is staged in the compliance drive. I can create an FAQ for sales/legal to reuse. Note: FedRAMP Authorization is "readiness" work here; we are not claiming full authorization yet.

ana (small correction): sorry typo — should be "ana" above, not "nana" :sweat_smile:

ana (deleted message):

deploy-bot: "rollout: private-v2.5 pilot prep checklist created by jia at 2026-03-24T15:00Z"

jia: Quick install snippet for air-gapped customers (put in docs):

```bash
./rwinf-installer --mode airgap \n  --kms-provider fips \n  --kms-endpoint https://kms.corp.example \n  --accept-eula \n  --image-bundle /tmp/rwinf-v2.5-bundle.tar.gz
```

sam: FYI — customers in EU will need explicit data residency toggles on the control plane. That toggle will be available in the next patch; for pilot, CS should ensure EU customers have a local deploy target.

oliver: Ops checklist (short): upgrade in maintenance window, snapshot DB, disable auto-scaling during canary, enable verbose logs for first 12h, gather perf histograms at 5m intervals.

maria: Signing up customers now. Can we get 2 engineers for paid migration support during week 1? @eng-manager pls advise.

ryan: Also flagging a few strategic accounts who requested FedRAMP-ready options — cc @sam @laura for pre-sales legal/security loop.

laura: We'll prepare standard contract addendum language. ETA: 3 business days.

ana: Ops note — deprecating legacy non-vpc appliance in 6 months. We will provide migration tooling but call it out to customers asap.

sam: Security ask — create a short changelog for customers detailing cryptographic primitives and KMS integrations we support in v2.5.

ana: Will do. Also scheduling an internal walk-through next Wed 10:00 PT — invite to follow. Please RSVP if you want a deep-dive.

maria: RSVP'd. CSMs will bring sample migration checklists and top 5 customer questions.

oliver: I'll coordinate the canary runbook rehearsal Tue 08:00 PT.

deploy-bot: "scheduled: private-v2.5 pilot kickoff 2026-03-30T16:00Z"

ana: Thanks everyone — big milestone for Private. If you're only reading and not part of pilot, please add :eyes: and we'll follow up with the recording.
